subtitle: A Greek Sailor Maps the Satavahana Sea-Roads

panels.shot: dramatic three-quarter view from behind the merchant, overlooking a dusk harbor filled with ancient ships and palm-lined wharfs
panels.action: The Periplus Merchant stands on a creaking wooden pier, wind tugging his cloak, as unfamiliar Deccan ships crowd a glowing harbor backed by low hills and distant basalt plateaus.

dialogue.text: In the first century of our era, a Greek-speaking sailor opened his notebook — and quietly mapped how Satavahana India tied its rocky heartland to the western sea.

i18n.hi: हमारी ईसवी की पहली सदी में, यूनानी बोलने वाला एक मल्लाह चुपचाप डायरी खोलता है — और देखता है कैसे सातवाहन भारत पहाड़ों से समुंदर से जुड़ता है।

panels.shot: tight overhead shot of a worn notebook on a ship’s table, lit by lamplight, waves visible beyond
panels.action: The Periplus Merchant leans over a low table on a gently swaying ship, his calloused hand steadying a worn wax tablet beside a small oil lamp and a rough map of the Indian Ocean.

dialogue.text: He was no governor or general, but a trader from an Egyptian port, writing in Greek for other sailors who followed the monsoon winds to India.

i18n.hi: वो न सूबेदार था, न सेनापति — मिस्र के बंदरगाह का सौदागर, जो यूनानी में लिखता था उन मल्लाहों के लिए जो मानसून के साथ इंडिया तक आते थे।

panels.shot: slow push-in on his focused face as he looks out to sea, horizon wide and hazy
panels.action: The Periplus Merchant raises his head from the tablet, his weathered face lit by dawn as he watches the pale line of an unknown coast emerge from the mist.

dialogue.text: Others dreamt only of Muziris and pepper. His notes turned south from Barygaza, into Dachinabades — the Deccan lands beyond the familiar charts.

i18n.hi: दूसरे बस मुज़िरिस और काली मिर्च के सपने देखते थे। उसकी लिखत भरूच से दक्षिण मुड़ती है, दक्खिनाबादेस — यानी नक्शों के परे दक्खन की धरती की ओर।

panels.shot: bird’s-eye view of a coastline with an inlet and clustered buildings, a ship approaching
panels.action: From above, a broad, shallow estuary opens onto a low shoreline dotted with huts and warehouses, as the merchant’s square-sailed ship eases toward a busy anchorage.

dialogue.text: First he marked Suppara — Sopara — a veteran harbor near the mouth of the ancient Narmada routes, once touched by Ashoka’s distant edicts.

i18n.hi: पहले वो नोट करता है सुप्पारा — सोपारा — पुराना बंदर, जहां से पुरानी नर्मदा राहें समुंदर से मिलती हैं, जिसे अशोक के फरमान कभी छू चुके थे।

panels.shot: medium shot from the pier, local boatmen and monks in the background as he observes
panels.action: Standing on a sandy bank lined with palm trunks and moored canoes, the Periplus Merchant watches shaven-headed monks and cloth-wrapped donors move toward a rock-cut shrine on a nearby hill.

dialogue.text: Here, cave-cut rock and old inscriptions showed long habit. Merchants had been dedicating chambers to the Buddha’s community long before any Greek sailor learned this coast.

i18n.hi: यहीं गुफाओं की चट्टानें और पुराने लेख बताते हैं पुरानी रिवायत। सौदागर बुद्ध-संघ को कक्ष चढ़ाते रहे, बहुत पहले कि कोई यूनानी मल्लाह इस किनारे को पहचाने।

panels.shot: map-like overhead melded with real terrain, dotted line tracing south from Barygaza past Sopara
panels.action: A stylized map of western India floats over the sea, with a dotted line dropping south from Barygaza to Suppara, while in the corner the merchant’s hand etches the Greek letters of ‘Suppara’.

dialogue.text: In his guide he recorded it simply: a harbor south of Barygaza, a step on the long coastal road binding northern trade with the Deccan interior.

i18n.hi: अपनी गाइड में वो बस इतना लिखता है: भरूच के दक्षिण का बंदर, लंबी तटीय राह का एक पड़ाव जो उत्तर के सौदे को दक्खन के भीतर से बांधता है।

panels.shot: wide coastal shot of a more developed harbor with jetty and larger buildings, monsoon clouds overhead
panels.action: Dark monsoon clouds hang over a deeper, better built harbor, with a stone jetty, timber warehouses, and larger indigenous ships drawn up as the merchant’s vessel waits offshore.

dialogue.text: Further south he found Kalliena — Kalyan — a richer harbor, where foreign ships were not free simply to wander in.

i18n.hi: और दक्षिण उसे मिलता है कल्लिएना — कल्याण — और भी अमीर बंदर, जहां पराये जहाज़ यूं ही आ-जा नहीं सकते।

panels.shot: low-angle view from his ship of sleek royal patrol boats approaching, flags streaming
panels.action: From the deck of his sea-worn ship, the Periplus Merchant watches sleek, low Satavahana patrol boats sweep out from Kalyan’s harbor, their carved prows and fluttering standards catching the spray.

dialogue.text: His notebook records a quiet warning: foreign vessels here were met by royal boats and escorted under watch toward Barygaza.

i18n.hi: उसकी डायरी में एक धीमी चेतावनी है: यहां पराये जहाज़ों को शाही नावें रोकती हैं, निगरानी में भरूच की ओर ले जाती हैं।

panels.shot: medium shot on deck as a Satavahana official gestures, the merchant listening cautiously
panels.action: On the deck, a Satavahana officer in layered cotton and a simple diadem stands firm, gesturing toward the north as the Periplus Merchant listens, hands open, the sea heaving around them.

dialogue.speaker: the_periplus_merchant
dialogue.text: We sail for trade, not trouble. We will follow your boats.

i18n.hi: हम सौदे के लिए चले हैं, झगड़े के लिए नहीं। तुम्हारी नावों के पीछे ही चलेंगे।

panels.shot: oblique overhead of both convoys sailing together along the coast, harbors in the distance
panels.action: Seen from high above, the merchant’s bulky vessel trails behind slender royal craft as they move in formation up the coastline, small harbors and river mouths dotting the green shore.

dialogue.text: Trade routes were not just lines on water. They were guarded corridors, where Satavahana authority reached out in boats and tolls, not only in stone inscriptions inland.

i18n.hi: ये राहें सिर्फ पानी की लकीरें नहीं। ये पहरेदार गलियारे हैं, जहां सातवाहन हुकूमत नावों और महसूल से फैलती है, सिर्फ भीतर की पत्थर की लिखाइयों से नहीं।

panels.shot: wide harbor shot of Semylla (Chaul) with rugged headland and anchored ships, waves breaking on rocks
panels.action: At a rocky headland where waves shatter against black stone, the merchant’s ship rides at anchor off a bustling shore, as local craft shuttle between sea and the low town nestled behind the trees.

dialogue.text: He also wrote of Semylla — likely Chaul — another harbor on this chain, each inlet a knot tying sea, river and inland track.

i18n.hi: वो सेम्यल्ला का भी ज़िक्र करता है — शायद चौल — इस ही कड़ी का एक और बंदर, जहां हर खाड़ी समुद्र, नदी और भीतर की राह को एक गांठ में बांधती है।

panels.shot: transition map shot zooming from coast inland along a caravan route toward the Deccan plateau
panels.action: A caravan road snakes inland from the coast up into rising plateau, tiny figures and pack animals marking the route, while the merchant’s stylus draws a line from Kalyan toward Paethana and Tagara.

dialogue.text: From Kalyan and its neighbors, he traced inland roads to Paethana — Pratishthana — and to the great cotton mart of Tagara, the Satavahana heartland beyond the ghats.

i18n.hi: कल्याण और उसके पड़ोसियों से वो भीतर की राहें पकड़ता है पैथना — प्रतिष्ठान — और कपास के बड़े बाज़ार तगर तक, घाटों के पार सातवाहन दिल की ओर।

panels.shot: ground-level shot of a caravan leaving the port, bales and ivory visible, merchant observing
panels.action: On a dusty road just beyond the harbor, the Periplus Merchant watches as oxen haul bales of cotton cloth and tusks of ivory inland, dust rising around carters’ bare feet and simple turbans.

dialogue.text: In his list the sea-borne spices fade. Cotton textiles, ivory, agate, carnelian and fine onyx move instead, passing through his hands only after long journeys from interior towns.

i18n.hi: उसकी सूची में समुंदर वाले मसाले धुंधले पड़ जाते हैं। अब कपड़े, हाथी-दांत, माणिक, कार्नेलियन और महीन ओनेक्स चलते हैं, जो दूर अन्दरूनी नगरों से लंबा सफर करके उसके हाथ तक पहुंचते हैं।

panels.shot: close-up of his hands handling a roll of cotton cloth and a string of carnelian beads
panels.action: In the shaded interior of a warehouse, the merchant’s rough fingers test a bolt of tightly woven cotton while his other hand lifts a string of warm red carnelian beads to the light.

dialogue.speaker: the_periplus_merchant
dialogue.text: Not pepper, but cloth and stone. The Deccan sells its earth and loom.

i18n.hi: यहां काली मिर्च नहीं, कपड़ा और पत्थर बिकते हैं। दक्खन अपने करघे और मिट्टी बेचता है।

panels.shot: interior of a Satavahana market town street, with guild banners and stone houses
panels.action: On a narrow street lined with stone-fronted houses and shopfronts, guild flags hang as traders in varied dress bargain over weighed goods; the Periplus Merchant walks through, observing, unarmed.

dialogue.text: Behind his brief phrases lie whole towns of artisans and guilds, Satavahana coins and local contracts, none of which he fully understood, yet all of which fed the harbors he named.

i18n.hi: उसकी छोटी लाइनों के पीछे पूरे शहर हैं — कारीगर, शेरों पर सातवाहन सिक्के, स्थानीय सौदे, जिन्हें वो पूरा नहीं समझता, पर जिनसे उसके हर बंदर की रौनक चलती है।

panels.shot: evening harbor shot back at the ship, sea darkening, merchant writing by lamplight
panels.action: Night settles over the harbor as the merchant sits cross-legged on deck near the mainmast, lamplight pooling over his tablet while the silhouettes of palm trees and distant hills darken against the sky.

dialogue.text: He wrote sparingly. Kalliena, Suppara, Semylla, Paethana, Tagara. A chain of names, each a point where Satavahana power touched the sea and foreign capital tasted inland wealth.

i18n.hi: वो कम बोलता है। कल्लिएना, सुप्पारा, सेम्यल्ला, पैथना, तगर — नामों की एक कड़ी, जहां-जहां सातवाहन ताकत समुंदर को छूती है, और पराया पैसा भीतर की दौलत चखता है।

panels.shot: extreme close-up on the etched Greek letters for Kalliena and Tagara on his tablet
panels.action: The camera lingers on the tablet surface where neat Greek letters spell out Kalliena and Tagara, the wax uneven from previous erasures and additions.

dialogue.text: He did not know he was sketching a political map: who controlled which harbor, who taxed which road, where officials guarded strangers and where older merchant communities held sway.

i18n.hi: उसे ख़बर भी नहीं कि वो सियासत का नक्शा बना रहा है: कौन किस बंदर पर बैठा है, किस राह पर कर बसूलता है, कहां मुलाज़िम परायों को घेरते हैं, और कहां पुराने सौदागर इख़्तियार में हैं।

panels.shot: time-lapse style montage: ships sailing, coins exchanged, Satavahana inscription on rock, then back to his book
panels.action: A silent montage shows ships coming and going, Satavahana coins changing hands, an inscription being chiseled into a rock face, before dissolving back into the Periplus Merchant’s open notebook centuries earlier.

dialogue.text: Modern archaeologists read his notes beside stone caves near Sopara, coins from Pratishthana, and inland roads cut into basalt, weaving his coastal handbook into India’s own records.

i18n.hi: आज के पुरातत्ववेत्ता उसकी लिखत को सोपारा की गुफाओं, प्रतिष्ठान के सिक्कों और बेसाल्ट में कटी भीतर की राहों के साथ पढ़ते हैं, उसकी तटीय किताब को भारत की अपनी गवाही में पिरोते हैं।

panels.shot: final wide shot from high above: the merchant’s ship tiny on the sea near the Deccan coast, notebook resting beside him
panels.action: From far above, the Periplus Merchant’s small ship is a speck against the dark Deccan shoreline, his notebook lying closed beside him as the monsoon wind fills the sail.

dialogue.text: Today his Periplus is our narrow window on a wide world, reminding us that a sailor’s route book can expose how empires claimed seas, guarded harbors and turned every path of commerce into a path of power.

i18n.hi: आज उसका ‘पेरिप्लस’ हमारा छोटा सा झरोखा है एक बहुत बड़े दौर पर, जो दिखाता है कैसे एक मल्लाह की राह-पुस्तक बताती है कि साम्राज्य समुंदर कैसे मांगते थे, बंदर कैसे बचाते थे, और हर सौदे की राह को ताकत की राह बना देते थे।

subtitle_i18n.en: A Greek Sailor Maps the Satavahana Sea-Roads
subtitle_i18n.hi: एक यूनानी मल्लाह और सातवाहन समुंदर-रास्ते
